label: Screen OCR Multi-Machine DB
info:
Multi-Machine Screen OCR Data Receiver & Database Logger.
Collects readings from all machines and stores them into database tables:
1. machine_ocr_logs (Full historical log)
2. machine_current_status (Latest live value per machine)

name: === MULTI-MACHINE SCREEN OCR TO DATABASE FLOW ===
info:
This flow receives OCR readings from multiple machine clients and logs them into a MySQL / SQLite database.

All machines can send to: POST /api/screen-ocr
Payload:
{
  "machine_name": "MC-04",
  "line_name": "Line-01",
  "value": "150",
  "previous_value": "140",
  "timestamp": "2026-09-06 22:17:38"
}

name: Validate & Extract Machine Data
NOTE: Double-click MySQL node to configure Host, User, Password & Database
info:
To connect your MySQL / MariaDB:
1. Double-click either DB node ('DB: Insert machine_ocr_logs' or 'DB: Update machine_current_status')
2. Click the pencil icon next to 'Database'
3. Set:
   - Host: 127.0.0.1 (or database server IP)
   - Port: 3306
   - User: root (or your db username)
   - Password: your_password
   - Database: ocr_db
4. Click Update -> Deploy
